title: Fresh Kiz Festival – 4th Edition
description:
🌊 The Fresh Kiz Festival is back for a fourth edition! 🌊
Our goal is to promote artists who have recently emerged on the scene (the “new generation” as we like to call them), those who have developed an innovative style or concept, and those who have had little exposure at festivals (but who are just as deserving), by offering them visibility and a space to share their art.
Fresh Kiz is also innovative in the form of the event itself, as well as in its interaction with the public, both before and during the event.
We aim to create a friendly, safe and trustworthy atmosphere, where everybody feels safe and at home🩵
